visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with pigtails wearing a yellow shirt with red apple patterns and gray shorts walks through a doorway into a room. She is wearing large, red-rimmed toy glasses. The background features white storage bins and another child playing in the distance under bright indoor lighting. (2) The girl walks toward the camera, stops, and looks down as her glasses fall to the floor. She picks them up and attempts to put them back on, her hands fumbling with the frame. The room has light wood flooring and minimal furniture. (3) Close-up shots of the girl's face show her concentrated expression while trying to wear the glasses. An adult's hands enter the frame to assist, placing the arms of the glasses over her ears. (4) In a different scene, the girl is now wearing a black and white striped shirt. She stands in a room with a large screen projection in the background. She adjusts the red glasses again and then turns to walk toward the screen and storage shelves. (5) The video ends with a static pink screen featuring a cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' centered on the screen.
